summary: Backend testing for Memory Maker API complete. 25/25 pytest tests pass covering health, auth (401 flows + seeded Bearer token), photo CRUD (create/list/delete with data URI stripping + user scoping), memory generation validation (400 for empty prompt, missing/invalid photo_ids), and a REAL Gemini Nano Banana (gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview) generation that returned a non-empty base64 image via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Memory list/get/delete/404 flows all correct. All endpoints are auth-gated and user-scoped as intended.

minor.issue: No size/format validation on image_base64; a very large or malformed string is accepted and stored. Consider max-length and base64 validity check.
photo_ids fan-out fetches up to 20; larger arrays silently truncated. Consider explicit cap + 400 when exceeded.
Assumes 'email' and 'session_token' present in Emergent response; raises 500 (KeyError) if missing. Consider defensive parsing -> 401.

action_items: (Optional) Harden POST /api/auth/session parsing against missing keys from Emergent response.
(Optional) Add explicit input validation (base64 correctness, max size) to POST /api/photos and POST /api/memories/generate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 330-line file — acceptable now but split into routers/, models/, services/ when it grows.
get_current_user relies solely on Mongo TTL for session expiry; extra explicit expires_at check present -- good.
Environment variables are read via os.environ[...] with no defaults — good, fails fast.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded in all queries via projection {'_id': 0}.
seed_data_creation: Seeded via pytest session-scope autouse fixture directly in MongoDB (test_database): users{user_id=user_testabc123, email=tester@example.com, name=Tester} and user_sessions{session_token=test-token-abc, expires_at=+7d}. Cleaned up on session teardown along with any photos/memories created during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints are covered by pytest suite in /app/backend/tests. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Real Gemini image generation is exercised in test_generate_memory_real_gemini_returns_image (consumes EMERGENT_LLM_KEY credits ~once per run, ~4-8s response). Reference photo pulled from https://i.pravatar.cc/300; test skips if unreachable. BASE_URL is loaded from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env).
